description: A gene is detected as expressed in an anatomical structure by a strict majority of Bgee detection calls across at least three admissible sequencing libraries. An absent edge is not a negative assertion of expression.

common_properties.name: fraction_present
common_properties.description: Fraction of admissible libraries for the gene–anatomy pair that Bgee called present. Library counts are not stored, so the denominator cannot be recovered from this edge.

common_properties.name: mean_log2_tpm
common_properties.description: Mean log2(TPM + 1) across all admissible libraries for the pair, including both present and absent calls. Zero-TPM observations are retained as zero.

common_properties.name: mean_rank
common_properties.description: Mean within-library rank across the pair’s admissible libraries.

common_properties.name: min_p_value
common_properties.description: Smallest detection p-value among the pair’s admissible libraries.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the relationship was created or updated.

source_contributions.scope: Processed human RNA-Seq measurements from adult developmental stages, including post-juvenile stages, for Uberon anatomical structures. Non-call-eligible measurements, fetal/child/teen stages, life-cycle or unrecognized stages, and Cell Ontology entities are excluded. Sex, strain and library type are neither filtered nor stored.
source_contributions.description: Expression is based on Bgee’s present/absent calls, with no TPM threshold used in the vote. Present calls must strictly outnumber absent calls; ties and absent majorities produce no edge. Expression and up-/down-regulation relationships are independent, so either may occur without the other. Per-library and per-experiment identities are not stored.
